adjudication.rationale: In `TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve`, when `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` is true it calls `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` inline and does not rescue any errors. `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed` performs network I/O (`open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)`) and parsing (`SimpleRSS.parse`), either of which can raise; if an exception occurs, execution will abort before reaching the `fetch_http` fallback later in `perform_retrieve`, so the embed URL will not be retrieved in that case.
